items.followUp: Explain star topology and bus topology.

rubric.why: Describes the ring arrangement of devices.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that devices are connected in a closed loop, with each device linked to its two neighboring devices.

rubric.why: Gives a valid characteristic of data transmission in a ring.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining that data passes from device to device around the ring.

rubric.why: Describes the interconnected arrangement of a mesh.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that devices have direct links to other devices; in a full mesh, each device connects to every other device.

rubric.why: Gives a valid characteristic of mesh topology.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for noting its reliability or its high cost due to many connections.

modelAnswer: In Ring Topology, each computer is connected to two neighboring computers, forming a closed loop. Data passes from one computer to another around the ring.
In Mesh Topology, computers are connected by direct links; in a full mesh, each computer is connected to every other computer. It is reliable but requires many connections and is expensive.
